applicabilityBasis.summary: SOFID is a U.S. dollar payment stablecoin issued by SoFi Bank, N.A. with 1:1 mint and redemption.

genius.notes: Re-checked 2026-09-29: no SoFiUSD reserve attestation is publicly filed. EDGAR full-text search returns no SoFiUSD attestation, and SoFi Bank N.A. ABS-15G filings (March–September 2026) are Deloitte agreed-upon-procedures reports for consumer-loan securitization trusts, not stablecoin reserve attestations. The May 27, 2026 retail-launch release cites regular attestations by an independent U.S.-licensed CPA without naming cadence or attestor; monthlyAttestationPresent stays false pending a published report.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific public GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official application source was located for SOFID as of 2026-06-18. GENIUS Act is law (enacted July 2025) but implementing regulations remain in proposed-rules phase; no PPSI applications have been accepted yet. SoFi Bank N.A. is an OCC-supervised IDI and under GENIUS would issue via a subsidiary; no such subsidiary PPSI application was found.
